experiment_label: accelerated D1 synthetic growing pod-demand-proxy replay on a benchmark Kubernetes service
selection_rule: Use the test split and the lowest numeric non-cyclic growing scenario ID. Within that scenario, select the earliest 42-observation contiguous window attaining the maximum positive ordinary least-squares pod_count slope. Ties resolve to the earliest start. The rule and result were frozen before any controller outcome was observed.

transformation.time: Each observed 900-second source interval becomes one constant 10-second replay bin (90x acceleration).
transformation.mapping_interpretation: controller-independent experimental demand proxy, not reconstructed HTTP traffic
transformation.interpolation: none; observed values are held constant within each replay bin

time_scale_assessment.interpretation: Individual 10-second source bins are not reliably separable by 15-second CPU metrics/HPA cycles. The 420-second window nevertheless contains 28 metric resolutions and 42 PHPA sync periods, so only response to the sustained overall rise is interpreted. Native 10.5-hour timing is not claimed.

growth_response_definition.response: first observed desired/ready replica count above the last pre-onset telemetry value
growth_response_definition.proactivity_rule: A pre-onset scale-up is reported descriptively only if it follows the start of the rising replay; replica count alone is not evidence of causal prediction.
